title: performance-event
description: What the learner actually played, as heard by the mic. type 'note' = a sustained pitch, 'onset' = an attack with no pitch, 'calibration' = the shared latency offset measured by the clap calibration. time_sec is time since practice started on the mic clock; subtract latency_offset_ms to line it up with the song.

pitch.description: Detected concert-pitch MIDI; may have a fraction (cents).

latency_offset_ms.description: The ONE shared latency offset from clap calibration. Every comparison uses this same value.
